Around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], '''southern quadrant''' was the name given to a mostly uncharted region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], it was considered hazardous and only hosted a few disseminated settlements.
